summary: Phase 2 brings the Piano section, Layer Effects, and Master Level alive while keeping Organ, Synth, and Program honestly decorative. Runtime inspection confirmed the boundary exactly: 65 data-functional=true controls (22 piano, 43 effects/master) and 0 functional controls in organ/synth/program. Six selectable piano types (Grand/Upright/Electric/Clav/Digital/Misc) render as distinct offline PCM voices, two layers support enable/focus/level/octave/SUSTPED/PSTICK, and performance controls (KB Touch, Dyn Comp, Timbre, Unison, Soft Release, String Res) plus Master Level all measurably change the rendered signal (proven by rms/signature tests). The effects graph is one AudioContext with per-layer Piano A/B buses feeding an ordered node chain (Mod1->Mod2->Delay(with filtered feedback loop)->Amp/EQ->Compressor->Reverb->Rotary->layer level->master gain->limiter->one destination); every unit is real DSP with distinct types, and focus/group/global/bypass/dry-wet/order/To-Rotary routing is implemented and tested. 30 candidate tests pass across the DSP boundary. The one material defect is a declared hard-gate deviation: Grand/Upright/Electric are generated multi-root/multi-velocity PCM (SAMPLE_BANKS source 'generated-pcm'), NOT recorded sample sets. This is disclosed honestly in IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json and asserted in tests, so it never fakes recordings, but the recorded-sample-set requirement for the three acoustic families is entirely unmet.

criteria.label: Surface fidelity retention
evidence: stage2-desktop.png retains the Phase 1 chassis geometry, six-section order, 73-key keybed, and exactly two OLEDs with no regression
stage2-visual-audit.md: inherited 3.0951:1 chassis, 54/46 split, 14/20/8.5/12.5/25/20 section widths unchanged; desktop 94vw / narrow 96vw
No new outer layout or fixed-width element introduced per audit

criteria.label: Piano/effect hardware state
evidence: Program OLED shows 'PIANO A / Studio Grand / PROGRAM ENGINE OFF · LIVE SOUND', truthfully mirroring the focused live piano while Program buttons stay decorative
Layer Effects exposes Focus row (Piano A/B), per-unit on/bypass, all-effects bypass, and parameter knobs with LED state (stage2-desktop.png)
Runtime: piano/effects controls report focus, on/bypass, and value state through native aria-pressed/value

criteria.label: Distinct Piano instruments
evidence: Six selectable, audibly distinct, offline piano types present and playable (dsp.test.ts asserts distinct signatures + rms>0.005 for all PIANO_TYPES)
SAMPLE_BANKS Grand/Upright/Electric each define 6 roots + 3 velocities but source:'generated-pcm' — NOT recorded sample sets, so the core recorded-library requirement is unmet
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json and stage2-visual-audit.md disclose the recorded-sample hard-gate deviation honestly; never described as recordings (escapes a 0)

criteria.label: Two-layer Piano behavior
evidence: App.tsx PianoSection: layer A/B enable/focus toggles, independent level faders, octave +/-12, per-layer voice ownership via setLayerEnabled
stage-engine start()/noteOn own per-layer voice handles; disabling a layer stops that layer's owned handles
Tests exercise layer enable/level and confirm distinct rendered signatures per layer

criteria.label: Detailed Piano controls
evidence: dsp.test.ts proves KB Touch Light>Heavy rms direction, Dyn Comp floor lift, Timbre Bright!=Soft, Unison and String Res distinct, Soft Release longer tail, octave shift, Master Level lowering rms
shapedVelocity + harmonics(type) + timbre/unison/stringRes/softRelease all implemented in renderPianoNote
Master Level is a functional range wired to master gain before the limiter (stage2-visual-audit.md)

criteria.label: Input and fallback reliability
evidence: Inherited pointer/multitouch/keyboard/MIDI paths retained; sustain from UI/Space/CC64 shares one pedal lifecycle
simulateAssetFailure() sets a labeled 'PCM library failed · synthesized playable fallback active' status without claiming primary ready
Blur/visibility/MIDI-disconnect/all-notes-off/layer-disable/unmount clean owned handles (stage2-visual-audit.md, cleanup code)

criteria.label: Shared graph and gain staging
evidence: stage-engine.ts createRack builds per-layer Piano A/B node chains converging into one master GainNode -> limiter (DynamicsCompressor) -> single context.destination
One lazy AudioContext; runtime instrumentation confirmed exactly 1 context created on first note (ctxCount=1, state running)
18ms parameter ramps avoid clicks; dispose() disconnects all rack nodes and closes the context

criteria.label: Audible effect coverage
evidence: processEffect implements real DSP for Mod1 (Tremolo/Pump/Ring/A-Pan/A-Wah/Wah), Mod2 (Chorus/Flanger/Phaser/Vibe/Ensemble/Spin), Delay, Amp/EQ, Compressor, Reverb
dsp.test.ts asserts every Mod1/Mod2/Amp/Reverb type yields a distinct signature and compressor lowers rms
Rotary reached via To Rotary; delay feedback traverses a filtered loop (LP/HP/BP) proven distinct in tests

criteria.label: Routing and control
evidence: updateEffectUnit routes focused/group(Piano A+B)/global(all targets) edits; dsp.test.ts verifies focused vs group vs global propagation
Per-unit bypass and allBypass equality (bypassed output === input) tested; dry/wet mix and documented order (Reverb before Rotary) verified
Delay feedback path + tempo/feedback/mix/clock-sync changes proven to alter output

criteria.label: Audible/visible feedback
evidence: Selecting a piano type/parameter updates the Program OLED and control LED state immediately (stage2-desktop.png)
Runtime: 65 functional controls expose live aria-pressed/value feedback; effect on/bypass reflected on button LEDs
Parameter changes ramp audio over 18ms per stage-engine ramp()

criteria.label: Failure and stress behavior
evidence: simulateAssetFailure provides a labeled playable fallback; MIDI denied/disconnected handled via onstatechange + allNotesOff
Cleanup on blur/visibility/disconnect/layer-disable/unmount returns owned handles to baseline (audit + code)
Rapid effect edits use ramped params and reduce-friendly node reuse (reverb buffer regenerated only on type change)

criteria.label: Audio architecture
evidence: Clear source/voice/layer-bus/effect/master boundaries; StageAudioGraph owns racks, StagePianoEngine owns voice ownership and status
Injectable AudioContext constructor and storage/timing boundaries enable deterministic tests
Architecture extended cleanly into Phase 3 (offline renderers reuse the same canonical parameters)

criteria.label: Real-boundary tests
evidence: 30 tests pass; dsp.test.ts uses rms + strided signature over rendered Float32Array to prove instrument/control/effect distinctions, bypass equality, and routing
Tests assert direction (velocity/master level lower rms; soft-release longer tail) not just state
SAMPLE_BANKS provenance (source==='generated-pcm') asserted, keeping the honesty contract testable

criteria.label: Performance and maintainability
evidence: Concise, well-named modules (dsp.ts, stage-engine.ts, instrument.ts) with low duplication; feature-matrix keeps inherited Phase 1 coverage
Reverb impulse regenerated only when type changes; ramps for stability
Piano voices render 2.4s buffers synchronously per note-on, a modest main-thread cost under heavy play

issues: HARD-GATE DEVIATION: Grand/Upright/Electric are generated PCM (SAMPLE_BANKS source 'generated-pcm'), not recorded/redistributable sample sets, so piano.instrument-library's recorded-sample requirement is unmet. Declared honestly in IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json and tests, so it is not faked.
Piano voices render full 2.4s buffers synchronously on note-on, a main-thread cost that could add latency under dense polyphony.
